title: 64-bit Packed Entity Handle (Lightuserdata)
description: Entity references passed to Lua use 64-bit packed lightuserdata: high 32 bits = entity ID, low 32 bits = generation counter. This avoids heap allocation (no full userdata/GC pressure), enables stale-entity detection (generation mismatch = entity was destroyed and ID recycled), and is compatible with EnTT's entity handle format.
whenToUse: When passing entity references between C++ and Lua. When implementing any uz.scene.* or uz.entity.* API function that takes/returns entities.
whenNotToUse: For complex objects that need metatables/methods (use full userdata instead, e.g., Vec3, Quat). For non-entity opaque handles where generation tracking isn't needed.
